description: The Alouettes host the Blue Bombers in the CFL Eastern Division Final at Percival Molson Memorial Stadium. Montreal finished 14-4 and beat Winnipeg 37-10 here in October, while the Blue Bombers arrive at 9-9 having won three of their last four.
